title: Help, Onboarding & Researcher Guidance
based_on: AGROLATTICE 11.16 — Platform Control Centre, Data Settings & Tool Catalogue
database_migration: No schema changes. All protected scientific databases remain on their 11.16 schemas.
headline_features: Help Command Centre with Start Here, guided workflows, workspace guides, data readiness, scientific labels, terminology, troubleshooting and search.
Context-aware onboarding progress derived from persistent AGROLATTICE records without running heavy analysis.
Consistent What do I need here? panels across all primary research/data workspaces.
Standardised scientific evidence vocabulary and interpretation boundaries across the guidance layer.
Guided workflows for fields/seasons, experiments, maize synchrony, Persistent Twins, model validation, decision-to-outcome and reproducible reporting.
Expanded contextual hover-help terminology and current-release documentation.
limitations: Readiness is metadata-based and does not rerun complete QC/validation on every workspace entry.
Full interactive browser verification requires the target Streamlit environment.
Highly specialised legacy/advanced workflows remain discoverable through All Tools rather than receiving dedicated onboarding sequences.
